rv.q: It’s such a ridiculous plot development that it’s almost impossible to take the rest of the tale seriously.

For a thriller, however, 'Sandra' doesn't quite succeed as a thrill ride...Audiences at 'Sandra' can imagine the story's twists and tensions well enough, but with the tools of a visual medium like theatre at its disposal, they shouldn't just have to imagine.
At points the narrative drags...What saves the show is the elegant production design and, of course, Marshat herself. She is an inherently interesting woman.
